_comment: Master crosswalk: proprietary → anonymized names. Source of truth for anonymization.
_instructions: Names kept close to originals per user preference. Only org/vendor prefixes removed.
_schema_note: Two schemas with procs: Reporting (21 files) and COOK_RPT (7 files). Mapped to 'reporting' and 'reports' to match folder structure.

procedures._comment_schema_reporting: These 21 procs live in [Reporting] schema → anonymized to [reporting]
procedures._comment_schema_cook_rpt: These 7 procs live in [COOK_RPT] schema → anonymized to [reports]

tables._comment: All tables from all 28 procs. Org-specific tables get renamed; Epic standard tables keep names.

columns._comment: Column-level Epic-dialect renames (verdict 2026-08-16, reversing the earlier keep-as-is call): CSN family, PAT_/HSP_ prefixes, _C->_CODE, _YN->_FLAG, SERV_AREA. Generated rule-based, collision-checked per table. Word-boundary, case-insensitive.

hardcoded_ids._comment: These IDs are org-specific Epic config. Replace with generic sequential IDs.
hardcoded_ids._strategy: Replace with same-length numeric IDs starting from 900001, 900002, etc.

_scan_note: Terms ending ~cs match case-sensitively (see src/anonymization.py scan_for_missed): org terms that are also common English words would otherwise false-flag generated prose ('ensuring clarity'). Each gets three casings: ProperNoun, ALLCAPS, lowercase_ identifier prefix.
